Ọmọ Lọmọ.definition: Ọmọ Lọmọ [literally] translates to "baby baby." It is a Yoruba pet name referring to a [beautiful] lady who came from a [beautiful] mother.
Ọmọ Lọmọ.example:
"I met this [beautiful] Ọmọ Lọmọ [yesterday] at the Nigerian Embassy while getting my passport renewed."
"I was dancing with this [beautiful] Ọmọ Lọmọ."
